messages:
maya: Morning — quick heads up: saw a spike of unassigned leads overnight, looks like enrichment webhook timeouts. Anyone else?

jordan: Yep, noticed ~30 unassigned between 02:10-02:30 UTC. HS webhook 504s.

sasha: Confirmed. Enrichment worker pool hit memory pressure, some jobs retried then dropped. We should enable a fallback routing path.

maya: Proposed immediate mitigation: after 20s of no enrichment, mark lead `enrichment=timed_out` and run round-robin using available HS fields. Tag leads with `fallback-enrich`.

jordan: Agree. Also enable 3x retries on the enrichment webhook with 8s backoff to reduce transient failures.

sasha: I'll implement the feature flag `enrich_fallback_toggle` and run staging tests.

ops-bot: DEPLOYMENT: enrich_fallback_toggle -> staging by sasha at 2167001200

maya: Please also prepare a 2-line SDR message: "Some leads may have partial data — verify before outreach." Pin KB link.

jordan: Backfill SQL ready (dry-run first). Will coordinate with ops.

ops-bot: ALERT: inbound_unassigned_count 30 (threshold 10) 2026-03-18 02:10-02:30 UTC

maya: Thanks team. After prod flip, let's track fallback_claim_pct and claim_latency. We'll schedule a retro to fix parallelism.
